title: Batch Normalization Forward
signature: def batchnorm_forward(x, gamma, beta, running_mean, running_var, momentum=0.9, eps=1e-5, train=True) -> tuple
hints: In training mode, the statistics come from the batch: mean and variance over axis 0 for each feature.
Use the biased variance (divide by N) both to normalize and to update the running variance.
momentum weights the OLD running value: new = momentum * old + (1 - momentum) * batch.
In eval mode, normalize with the running statistics and return them unchanged.
